external_deps: Google Cloud account for most skills

review.tagline: Agent Skills for Google Cloud, GKE, BigQuery, Ads and Firebase
review.summary: A repository of Agent Skills (Markdown skill folders) for Google products, mostly Google Cloud: GKE, BigQuery, AlloyDB, Cloud Run, IAM, SecOps, Genkit and the Gemini APIs. Install with `npx skills add google/skills`, choosing skills, target agents and project or global scope. It also bundles plugins (skills plus MCP servers) for Claude Code, Codex and Antigravity CLI.
review.audience: Engineers using coding agents on Google Cloud, GKE, Firebase or Google Ads
strengths: Broad coverage: over 150 skills across GKE, data, security, ads and AI/ML
Installable per skill, per agent and per scope via npx skills
Plugin bundles for Claude Code, Codex and Antigravity CLI
Apache-2.0 licensed, with an issue tracker for skill content fixes
weaknesses: Focused on Google products; little use outside Google Cloud, Ads or Firebase
Documented install path requires Node.js and npx
No tagged releases; installs track the repository head
Some skills are marked Public Preview, such as the API Gateway MCP server
needs: Needs Node.js (npx), Google Cloud account for most skills
